blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Hot and humid conditions are expected across the Visayas on Wednesday, October 28, despite generally fair weather, the state weather bureau said. Weather specialist Chenel Dominguez of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the heat might be more pronounced from noon to afternoon. READ: Pagasa: Amihan season officially begins, cooler days expected However, partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms may occur due to localized thunderstorms, particularly from afternoon to evening.
